# ITdsQueryExecutor

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.ITdsQueryExecutor`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Executes SQL queries against Dataverse&#x27;s TDS Endpoint (read-only replica) using the SQL Server wire protocol on port 5558.

### Methods

#### ExecuteSqlAsync

```text
public System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryResult> ExecuteSqlAsync(System.String sql, System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> maxRows = default, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Executes a SQL query against the Dataverse TDS Endpoint and returns structured results.

- Parameter `sql`: The SQL SELECT query to execute.
- Parameter `maxRows`: Optional maximum number of rows to return. If null, returns all rows.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: The query result containing records, columns, and execution metadata.

Remarks: The TDS Endpoint is read-only. Only SELECT statements are supported. The connection uses the org URL on port 5558 with an MSAL access token.
